question: By what agency is the yoginī named Wish said to extend up to Māyā?
premises: The yoginī named Wish is named thus.
She is associated with the siddhas.
By supreme will she extends up to Māyā.
inference: The yoginī named Wish, in relation to the siddhas, extends up to Māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The exact relation between the siddhas and this yoginī is not specified.
plain_english: The yoginī named Wish, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to Māyā.
